description: A dark oil-style painting of a gaunt man in a caped dark overcoat, in profile, holding a small framed photograph of a woman. Behind him a masked figure in a fur-collared coat stands by a high-backed armchair. The room is cluttered Victorian with shelves of bric-a-brac, framed pictures, patterned wallpaper, a fireplace with a fire, and drifting smoke. No visible text, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.
